lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a staggered, multi-row grid posterior to the branchial region, following roughly horizontal trajectories along the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal patterning to form a grid-like lattice, with high-luminance blobs acting as primary nodes at these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance (superior) to shadow (inferior).

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of at least four small, elongated high-contrast objects (commensal fish) is visible beneath the ventral surface and pectoral fin.
